outcomeNote: A single anonymous mishna ruling; no dispute, no argument, and no second party to interact with.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמַּעֲלֶה אֶת הָעוֹף עִם הַגְּבִינָה עַל הַשֻּׁלְחָן – אֵינוֹ עוֹבֵר בְּלֹא תַעֲשֶׂה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One who places» the meat of «birds with cheese on the table» upon which he eats «does not» thereby «violate» a Torah «prohibition.»

moves.cueHe: המעלה את העוף עם הגבינה על השלחן
moves.summary: The mishna rules that merely placing bird meat and cheese together on the table is not a Torah transgression.
